title: Funding Deadlines, Cut-off Times and Accepted Funding Methods — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
## Funding calendar by package

Each payroll batch of a Paystride Payroll Card Program is funded by a deadline set in business days before its pay date, by a cut-off time in Eastern Time on the deadline day, using a method the package accepts. Under an ACH debit authorization Paystride initiates the debit a set number of business days before the pay date, and a funded regular batch posts to cards by a set Eastern Time on the pay date.

| Package | Funding deadline (business days before the pay date; 0 means the pay date itself) | Cut-off time on the deadline day (ET) | Accepted funding methods | ACH debit initiated (business days before the pay date) | Regular batch posts by (ET, on the pay date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 2 | 14:00 | employer ACH credit; ACH debit authorization | 3 | 06:00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 2 | 14:00 | employer ACH credit; ACH debit authorization | 3 | 06:00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 1 | 15:00 | employer ACH credit; ACH debit authorization; wire | 2 | 06:00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 1 | 15:00 | employer ACH credit; ACH debit authorization; wire | 2 | 06:00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 1 | 16:00 | employer ACH credit; ACH debit authorization; wire | 2 | 06:00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 0 | 17:00 | employer ACH credit; ACH debit authorization; wire | 1 | 06:00 |

### Calendar notes

- Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays.
- Wire funding is accepted only in the Select, Advantage, Premier and Elite packages.
- Under the Elite package the deadline day is the pay date itself.

Hypothetical calendar: for a regular batch with a pay date on a Friday with no holiday in the week, a Standard package program's deadline is 14:00 ET on the Wednesday before, two business days earlier; a Premier package program's deadline is 16:00 ET on the Thursday, one business day earlier.
